ClamAV.description: ClamAV connection settings, used by the 'OrchardCore.Antivirus.ClamAV' feature to scan uploaded files with a 'clamd' service before they are stored. When the feature is enabled, uploads are rejected until the scanner can verify them. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Antivirus/.

Host.description: The host name or IP address of the 'clamd' service (required), e.g. 'localhost'.

Port.description: The TCP port of the 'clamd' service.

ConnectTimeoutSeconds.description: The timeout, in seconds, when connecting to the 'clamd' service.

TransferTimeoutSeconds.description: The timeout, in seconds, when sending a file to and reading the result from the 'clamd' service.
